answer: A simple sybil defense is a refundable stake at the inlet: every agent must lock 200 credits before it can join, and the stake is slashed if peers catch it running duplicate identities. One honest agent risks 200 credits; an attacker cloning 500 fake agents must lock 100,000 credits up front, and losing the whole stake makes the attack unprofitable. The vine of trust grows only from staked agents, so the horizon of the economy stays limited to participants who paid to enter.
